description: This Java source file defines the StatusBarNotifications activity for an Android application. It demonstrates how to create, update, and cancel status bar notifications with various configurations, including custom views and default behaviors. It includes button click handlers to trigger different notifications illustrating features like ticker texts, custom RemoteViews, and notification defaults.

classes.name: StatusBarNotifications
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating how to add, update, and cancel status bar notifications with different configurations such as custom views, ticker texts, and default sounds/vibrations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI buttons and their click handlers to trigger different notification actions.

methods.name: makeMoodIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent that launches NotificationDisplay activity with specific mood image when notification is clicked.

methods.name: makeDefaultIntent
methods.description: Constructs an array of intents to provide a proper back stack for launching the app from a notification.

methods.name: setMood
methods.description: Builds and issues a notification with specified icon and message; can include a ticker.

methods.name: setMoodView
methods.description: Creates and issues a notification with a custom RemoteViews layout to display mood information.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Creates and posts a notification with default sound, vibration, or all defaults based on parameter.
